summary: Thumbnail gallery with a modal viewer and keyboard navigation.
whenToUse: Showing a collection of images and enlarging them without leaving the page.
whenNotToUse: To edit or crop an image, use ImageCropper.

props.name: images
props.description: Images with id, src, alt and optional thumbnails or captions.

props.name: selectedId / defaultSelectedId / onSelectionChange
props.description: Active image; null closes the viewer.

keyboard.action: Opens the gallery, reaches the controls and closes the dialog.
Navigates images in the viewer; arrow keys respect RTL.

accessibility: Uses Dialog to manage focus, closing and the accessible name.
Thumbnails are buttons with an accessible name.
responsive: The grid adapts to the available width.
customization: Colors, borders and spacing use tokens.
commonMistakes: Provide descriptive alternative text and unique ids.
limits: Does not upload files or apply edits to images.
